tasks.task: Build the one-page weekly store report

items.when: Every Monday, to run the pull, the checks and the write-up in the same order each week
When you have the order export and the analytics export and need the one-page report
Before you quote a Shopify tile, to know which tiles to trust and what cash was really collected
When store and analytics numbers disagree this week and you must say which one to trust
When one striking number is about to lead the report and nobody has asked what it counts

tasks.task: Break sales down by channel and campaign

items.when: When the owner sells on several channels and wants revenue, units and order value for each
When you need revenue and orders by campaign, source and medium from tagged order links
When you have GA4 exports and need conversion by channel and by landing page
When two reports give one sale to different channels and you must pick a rule and explain it
When a channel claims sales and you must ask whether its ads caused them

tasks.task: Explain a sales dip or spike

items.when: When sales moved and the owner wants the cause step by step, tracking breaks ruled out first
When you need the change split into visits, conversion and order value before you look for causes
When the first split shows nothing, to cut the change by group and rank the drivers
Before you send the cause, to test the method, the sums and any bias in the story

tasks.task: Reconcile store orders with analytics and ad platforms

items.when: When the store and GA4 show different orders or revenue, before anyone reads a trend
When Meta, Google and GA4 each report a different sales count and you need the reason for each gap
When the money paid out does not match the orders and each payout must be tied to its orders

tasks.task: Check GA4 ecommerce tracking before trusting it

items.when: When GA4's sales reports look empty, too high or too low, or before you build a funnel on them
When you take on a store, to list missing settings and store events with a setup score
When Google Ads may count one purchase twice and you need a pass or fail on each action
Once a month, to re-test the tracking so a quiet break does not sit in the reports

tasks.task: Size how much data consent and blockers hide

items.when: When analytics shows fewer visits or orders than the store, most of all in the EU and UK
Before you size the gap, to get the store and analytics totals lined up on the same dates
When you must report a number you know is partly missing and say how sure you are

tasks.task: Score customers and name the segments

items.when: When you have an order export and need every customer scored and grouped in plain words
When the store is connected and you want the scores and groups run straight on its customers
When the usual score groups feel forced, to find natural groups from what customers do
When the owner asks what the best and worst buyers have in common and which ads brought them
Before scoring, to find one person held as two records, which would split their history

tasks.task: Write an action plan for each customer segment

items.when: When the groups are sized and you need each one's share of customers and revenue first
When each group must become an email audience with clear include and exclude rules
When the plan leans only on loyal buyers and ignores the many light buyers who bring growth

tasks.task: Show repeat purchase by first-order month

items.when: When you need the first-order month table from an order export, with young months marked
When the store is connected and you want repeat rate and revenue per first-order month
When the question is which first product or collection leads to a second order
When the table needs to be a colour grid the owner can read in one look
When repeat rate is low and you need the step between first and second order that fails

tasks.task: List good customers who have gone quiet

items.when: When you want a ranked list of good customers who have gone quiet, for a win-back or a note
When each buyer should be judged against their own buying rhythm, not one cut-off for all
When the owner wants the win-back emails too and you need the full run to hand over

tasks.task: Work out contribution margin per order and product

items.when: When you have order, cost, shipping, fee and refund exports and need margin in layers
When you need each product's margin and a clear list of the ones that lose money
When shipping looks like the leak and you need charged against paid, by carrier and method
When one product's price is in doubt and you need true margin and the break-even ad return

tasks.task: Break returns down by product and reason

items.when: At the monthly review, or when one product seems to come back too often
When the store is connected and you want return reasons counted by product
When you need refund rate by product, collection or date to spot a quality or listing fault
When the owner asks what returns really cost: refunds, lost shipping and written-off stock
Each month, to name the products behind refunds and the one fix to make first

tasks.task: Build the monthly product and collection report

items.when: When the monthly report should use the same definitions and layout as the weekly page
When you need visits and conversion rate for each product and collection page
When the report should rank products by margin, not only by sales
When the owner asks which products sell together, for bundles and cross-sell
When order value over time is needed, split into new and returning buyers
When a best seller may be a loss maker once costs and returns are taken off

tasks.task: Find where the store funnel leaks

items.when: When you have the GA4 funnel by device and need the step that leaks most and why
When you have a raw event log and need drop-off and time to convert for each step
When conversion rate alone misleads and you need profit per visitor from corrected revenue
Each week, to watch product page to cart to checkout and flag the step that slipped
Before you trust any funnel step, to be sure the events behind it fire once and in order

tasks.task: Work out customer value and payback on ad spend

items.when: When you have first-order months and need repeat rate, customer value and true payback
When the owner asks the most they can pay to win a customer, by type and source
When the numbers are in and you need a scale or fix call on profit against cost to win

tasks.task: Measure what a discount or sale really earned

items.when: After a promotion, to set each code's extra revenue against what the discount cost
Before a sale, to show the ad return needed at that discount and margin
After the sale, to see margin per order once returns from sale buyers have come back

tasks.task: Build a reusable report sheet or dashboard

items.when: Before you build, to fix who reads it, what they decide and which few numbers they need
When two people mean different things by one number and the sheet needs one written meaning
When the report must rerun each week from the same pull into the same workbook
When one number needs a clean chart with the right chart type
Before handing the sheet over, to list formula errors, broken links and totals that do not tie
When the sheet is crowded and the reader cannot see what to do from it

tasks.task: Forecast sales for the next weeks or a peak season

items.when: When you have past spend, first-order months and a calendar and need daily revenue against target
When you need trend, seasons and odd spikes pulled apart before any forecast
When the forecast is one hopeful number and needs a base rate, a range and a date to check it

tasks.task: Read an A/B test and say whether to ship

items.when: Before a test, to see if the store has enough visits and orders and how many weeks it needs
When the test has run and you need a split check, ranges and a ship call
When a result looks too good and you need the right test and a plain answer on whether it is real

tasks.task: Report stock cover and slow sellers

items.when: When the weekly report should flag products about to run out, by location
When you need products ranked into fast, steady and slow sellers with reorder points

tasks.task: Clean and check an export before analysis

items.when: When a new export arrives, to list gaps, duplicates and odd values before any sums
When the file is messy and must be fixed and re-checked until it passes, with rules kept

tasks.task: Run the quarterly customer review

items.when: In the first two weeks after a quarter ends, to run segments, cohorts and margin in order
When you rescore customers and compare group sizes with last quarter
When the review must show which groups and products made money after returns
When the review should say whether new customers from the quarter are paying back
When the full review is long and the owner needs one page with the answer first
Before the review goes out, to test the method and the sums

tasks.task: Write up findings in plain words for the owner

items.when: When a one-off analysis is done and needs the question, data, method and result written down
When the owner will read one page only and needs the answer, the money and the decision
When a chart carries the point, to check the chart type and axes do not mislead
When a finding sounds dramatic and needs its comparison and its doubt stated

always.when: On any analysis, to log each assumption and what would change the answer
Before any number leaves you, to test the method, the sums and the bias
Before you work on any export, to catch gaps, duplicates and odd values

helpers.when: When the segments or the slipping list need emails and flows written and run
When the funnel read finds a leaking page and someone must plan and run the tests
When the question is ad spend and channel credit across platforms, not store data
When the report sheet needs heavy formulas, pivots or an automated refresh
When the owner wants a designed dashboard, not a working sheet
When the stock read turns into reorder quantities and supplier lead times

gaps: No library item builds a monthly product and collection sales report from an order export; it has to be pieced together from page, profit and order-value readers
No library item sizes the analytics consent gap by country or browser; only the kit prompt covers it
No library item checks GA4 purchase events against store orders one by one to find missing or doubled orders
No library item combines sales from a store, a POS and marketplaces into one deduplicated report
No library item sets up a reusable weekly report sheet in Google Sheets or Excel with paste-in tabs for store exports
No library item gives two or three layouts of a store report to compare before the owner picks one
No library item reads repeat purchase or customer value by acquisition channel
No library item reviews a peak sale such as Black Friday after the event against last year
